dataset: endoflife.date — release cycles with release, active-support and end-of-life dates for 14 runtimes, operating systems, a database and a framework
publisher: endoflife.date contributors (community-maintained open data compiled from vendor release and support pages)
attribution: Data from endoflife.date (MIT License), https://endoflife.date/ — reshaped, not edited; a citation, not an endorsement by endoflife.date or any vendor.
updateCadence: endoflife.date changes continuously (community pull requests and automated vendor checks); refreshed here monthly, freshness reports due 35 days after the fetch.
verificationMethod: One request per product to https://endoflife.date/api/<product>.json on `fetched` (User-Agent "databutler.dev data curation (+https://databutler.dev)", 500 ms apart); each cycle's fields are kept under the names in cycleFields with nothing added — eol/support/extendedSupport are endoflife.date's values, which it compiles from the vendors' own lifecycle pages; the Ruby link template is filled with the latest release.

cycleFields.cycle: release cycle id as endoflife.date names it (e.g. "18", "3.11", "22.04", "11-24h2-w")
cycleFields.eol: end of life: the date security updates stop under standard support (YYYY-MM-DD); false = no end-of-life date set; true = end of life, date not recorded
cycleFields.lts: long-term-support status as published: true, false, or the date LTS status begins
cycleFields.latest: latest release in the cycle at the snapshot
cycleFields.support: end of active (feature and bug-fix) support (YYYY-MM-DD); true = in active support with no end date set; absent = not tracked for this product
cycleFields.extendedSupport: end of extended/paid support where the vendor offers one (YYYY-MM-DD); true = available, no end date set; absent = none
cycleFields.link: vendor release page endoflife.date records for the cycle
cycleFields.codename: release codename where the vendor uses one (Debian, Ubuntu, Android, macOS)
cycleFields.releaseLabel: display label where the cycle id is a slug (Windows, Android, macOS)
